title: 18 December 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles gave their 66th lunchtime performance at Liverpool’s Cavern Club on this day.

The group’s lunchtime shows in the Cavern typically lasted from 12-2pm. Overall this was their 99th appearance at the Mathew Street cellar club, including their late-night shows.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows at the Mathew Street venue between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.
